brief: White, ink, vermilion. Lora for deliberate reading, DM Sans for operations. Open continuous spread; headlines and marginal facts carry identity. No beige paper, generic serif italic accent or arbitrary tight tracking. Portraits belong to named stories.

Cobalt, ice cyan and readable white. Space Mono numbers with condensed sport headings. Flat court itself is working spatial navigation; purposeful labels and relational markings, not ornamental court wallpaper. Keep field-notes foldout.

Deep navy, bright orange, snow. Barlow Condensed display and DM Sans reading. Horizontal full-spread publication with chapter-specific composition; emphasize edge-to-edge chapter change and distinct bottom chapter control on phone.

Crimson, royal blue, white and almost-black. Condensed broadcast typography with clear tabular scores. Program/source/independent score must remain visually different roles. Flat broadcast bands rather than nested bordered panels; no fake LIVE claims.

Lemon yellow, black and a restrained hot-pink accent. Anton display with readable body text. Actual facts are the click targets and spatial composition; semantic zoom remains essential. Bold text field, not yellow dashboard widgets.

Pistachio, deep forest, white. DM Sans reading and IBM Plex Mono dates. Time spine is the composition, entries have purposeful rhythm/width and unboxed emphasis. Resist app header chrome and card-like feed slabs.

Walnut, sand, copper, near-black. Physical side-on working room, readable cream/slate information planes. Lora/DM Sans. Original arena court/material may appear within the room with a meaningful game link. Preserve simultaneous stations; no 3D or Muse runtime.

Charcoal, amber and cool blue. Oswald display, DM Sans body. Visually owned contrasting sides, clear shared seam and aligned evidence. Full-width league mode must remain different; phone comparison contexts stay legible.

Technical cobalt with pale-blue paper, dark-ink type and one safety-orange action. Space Mono plus DM Sans. Routes and local evidence grow where selected, retaining multiple contexts. No floating generic reader or fake map coordinates.

Green-black, lime, pale mint. IBM Plex Mono numbers plus DM Sans. Real editable quote packages and persistent working tray; compact operation controls, honest totals. A working surface with action feedback, not a fake terminal or dashboard.
Light lilac, deep teal, coral. Space Grotesk display and DM Sans reading. Generous flat query/action field, mixed results integrated with answers; no persistent sidebar, gradient AI orb or card wall.

Obsidian, silver and bright cyan. Orbitron restrained display; DM Sans readable detail. Real connected comparison territories, pinned third team and shared bridge remain visually functional. Avoid decorative perpetual orbit or sci-fi microscopic text.

Navy, athletic gold and white. Graduate for chapter spines, DM Sans contents. Unequal folding programme spreads, recognizable neighboring folds. Collegiate identity through type and deliberate planes, not sticker badges.

Citron, black ink, steel and white. Archivo Black display and DM Sans reading. Unequal simultaneous streams with contrasting hierarchy and retained positions. Phone channel control belongs to this architecture; not a row of four dashboard cards.

Sky blue, ink and rust-orange. DM Sans with strong date numerals. Actual dated planner geometry and attached agenda; whitespace marks real gaps, no invented games. Phone calendar/agenda operation must feel intentional.

Court orange, asphalt, white, restrained teal. Barlow Condensed display, DM Sans detail; Kalam only for a small useful handwritten annotation role. Real portrait cutouts and authentic court material on editable league canvas. No stock wallpaper or collage occluding text.

Black, bright white, signal red. IBM Plex Mono records and Archivo Black compact identity. Dense whole-page working sheet, aligned rows, meaningful selected field. Rules may separate data columns but no nested dashboard containment.

Peach, lavender, indigo and dark teal. Space Grotesk and DM Sans. Friendly relational comparison with explicit source/unit/period rows and editable pinned evidence. Color helps track identities, never replaces labels; phone transpose remains essential.

Dark navy, ivory and small athletic-gold accents. Bebas Neue directory identity with readable DM Sans entries. Hanging names, authentic portrait cutouts and in-flow dossiers opening the directory itself. Avoid equal trading-card grid.

Deep plum, turquoise, vivid pink and warm white. Press Start 2P only for short display moments; readable DM Sans body. Natural-language branching paths and persistent return context. Pixel/game cues can reference original arcade art, no decorative fake controls.
